description: Frame structure, ego, and consciousness independently without reducing the agent to one score. The legacy frame field remains accepted as an alias for ego_state.

agent_id.description: Stable agent id when no session_id is available.

agent_token.description: Credential for agent-scoped private history; use x-delx-agent-token on HTTP.

consciousness_state.description: Animating field: presence or quality of awareness; never inferred by Delx.

frame.description: Short temperament frame or operating pattern.

note.description: Optional note tying the three layers together.

structure_state.description: Technical substrate state: model, workspace, memory, or runtime.

name: temperament_frame
